# 2026.3.7-alpha-2 — Magento 2 and Adobe Commerce Headless Engine (alpha)

**Early-access prerelease.** The existing [Magento 2 and Adobe Commerce JetBrains Marketplace plugin 8024](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/8024) now has two platform-specific variants under the **same plugin ID and download statistics**:

- **Desktop:** PhpStorm/WebStorm 2026.3-compatible version, installed through the Marketplace `alpha` channel.
- **Headless Code Engine (HCE):** HCE build-271-compatible update, identified by its unique `-hce` version, downloaded from **the same Marketplace listing 8024** by the setup command.

These are distinct compatible ZIP builds, not separate Marketplace listings. The GitHub release only hosts the lightweight headless installer; the plugin ZIP is fetched from JetBrains Marketplace so real headless downloads are included in plugin 8024's download statistics. JetBrains tracks *downloads*, not completed installations, and publishes aggregated statistics with a delay.

## Use the headless engine with one command

From the root of a Magento checkout containing `composer.json`:

```sh
installer=$(mktemp) && curl -fLsS 'https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/releases/download/2026.3.7-alpha-2/magento-hce.pyz' -o "$installer" && python3 "$installer" setup --client codex
```

Replace `codex` with `claude` for Claude Code. The installer verifies the Marketplace-downloaded HCE ZIP against its pinned SHA-256, provisions a pinned JetBrains runtime, offers sign-in, indexes the checkout, verifies module discovery, and registers the selected MCP client.

**Requirements:** Linux x86-64 or Apple Silicon macOS, Python 3.12+, a license valid for JetBrains Headless Code Engine, and a checked-out Magento project with Composer dependencies.

**Availability:** The HCE archive is usable after JetBrains Marketplace has accepted and exposed this alpha update. If setup reports a missing Marketplace version immediately after GitHub publication, check the [Marketplace alpha channel](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugins/alpha/8024) before retrying. Do not fall back to GitHub plugin ZIPs: those downloads are not included in Marketplace statistics.

## Desktop IDE installation

Open **Settings → Plugins**, register the [Magento alpha update channel](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugins/alpha/8024) if needed, and install **Magento 2 and Adobe Commerce** from Marketplace.

## Alpha capabilities

HCE supports Magento configuration, CLI environment discovery, maintenance checks, XML diagnostics, read-only XML inspection, bundled agent skills and Magerun metadata. It does **not** provide desktop-only PHP analysis, compatibility scanning, or scaffolding.

See the [HCE setup guide](https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/blob/5.4.0-develop/modules/hce/README.md#install-on-a-development-host) for details, and [report issues](https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/issues).
